notes.title: Small update - fix for final boss
notes.content: - Number of issues fixed for the final boss of the game.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Twin Ruin Special edition
notes.content:
This is the big Update...
New in game Shops - weapon upgrades and new pickups
Rebalanced Gameplay
New triggering system 
Updated Boss systems and animations
Improved Navigation guides

plus hundreds of small changes through out the game.

Alot of time has gone into improving Twin Ruin, I hope you Enjoy.

notes.title: New Difficulty modes added
notes.content:
You can now choose easy mode when starting a game.  The polarity of the enemy doesn't affect the amount of damage it receives, so the game should be easier.  But as a result each enemy is worth half the score, when in easy mode.

Hard mode has the same difficulty as the original game.

- fixed custom controls not loading on boot.

notes.title: Small update - clean up some UI elements
notes.content: Survival mode UI elements clean up.

notes.title: New update - survival now has character select
notes.content:
Survival now has character select - unlock new characters and use their different abilities to improve your score?

- fix for steam score uploads not always working

- big improvement in super weapon effects for the alien and soldier characters.

- many other small tweaks to visuals.

notes.title: Big New update March 2022
notes.content:
Can you survive 3 mins and get the highest score.  New survival mode is a great way to get your skills up to scratch for the main game.

plus

- remap the game pad controls
- new survival leader-board
- main game renamed to Adventure

notes.title: January 15th Update
notes.content:
-Added improved player feedback for taking damage - rumble added.
-5 pages of tips added to start screen and pause screen, should help everyone improve their scores ;D
-Visual effects improved on a number of gfx, smart bomb is now a fiery orange. 
-moved tips toggle to character select screen
-In game tips are now less frequent,  added a tip to collect weapon chips.

Enjoy,  all feedback welcome.

notes.title: First Update - added features based on player feedback.
notes.content:
There is now a tip toggle to be able to turn off in game tips.

the warning screens can be skipped by pressing the polarity switch button.

the solider now has a better look super weapon projectile
-fixed the solider and alien having missing colliders for some types of projectiles
-fixed graphical issue with door switch.
